detail.method: one warp per sub-partition: ldmatrix.x2, its result XORed into an accumulator, then the next; cycles per link = the ldmatrix latency plus the XOR and loop (about 4 cycles)

method: the ldmatrix -> mma operand path: dependent latency, pipelined depth 1-3, swizzled vs not, 1-4 blocks per SM (round 2, B32)
